content.text:
The suite failed at first, and now all 3 tests pass.

The two failures in `test_paginate.py` came from one bug in `src/shop/paginate.py`. `page()` is 1-based, but it computed the start offset as `n * size` instead of `(n - 1) * size`. So page 1 returned items 3–5, and page 4 of 10 items came back empty. I changed that line to `start = (n - 1) * size` and removed the old "BUG" comment. I didn't touch the tests.

`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` now exits 0.
